item.title: 国行 Apple 智能开启测试，Siri、写作工具与视觉智能接入千问
item.guid: 国行-Apple-智能开启测试，Siri、写作工具与视觉智能接入千问
item.description:
Early this morning, Apple pushed the first developer beta of iOS 27.3, and the "Apple Intelligence and Siri" experience began to open in mainland China. 今天凌晨，苹果推送 iOS 27.3 首个开发者测试版，国行「Apple 智能与 Siri」开始开放体验。

The first batch of features listed on Apple's Chinese official website includes writing tools, real-time translation, photo erasure, smart emoji creation, and notification summaries. 苹果中文官网列出的首批功能包括写作工具、实时翻译、照片消除、智绘表情及通知摘要。

Qianwen has been integrated into Siri, Visual Intelligence, and writing tools, allowing users to ask questions, generate text, or process images within the system. 千问被整合进 Siri、视觉智能和写作工具，用户可在系统内提问、生成文本或处理图像。

According to iFanr's actual testing, Visual Intelligence's image search also integrates Baidu search. Siri now features a halo around the screen's edge and supports double-tapping the bottom of the screen to switch to text input. 据爱范儿实测，视觉智能的以图搜物还接入了百度搜索。Siri 换上环绕屏幕边缘的光晕，并支持双击屏幕底部切换为文字输入。

In Siri, basic Q&A can be completed directly. Taking "I haven't been sleeping well lately" as an example, Siri will call on Qianwen to provide general sleep advice. 在 Siri 中，基础问答可直接完成。以「最近总是睡不好」为例，Siri 会调用千问给出通用睡眠建议。

For more personalized solutions, users can click the Qianwen Logo to jump to the Qianwen App, and conversation information will be automatically synchronized. It is understood that Qianwen can formulate improvement plans based on users' previous sleep records, exercise status, and living habits. 如需更个性化的方案，用户可点击千问 Logo 跳转至千问 App，对话信息会自动同步。据了解，千问可结合用户此前的睡眠记录、运动情况和生活习惯制定改善方案。

Real-time translation covers messages, phone calls, and FaceTime, with phone calls and FaceTime limited to one-on-one conversations. AirPods translation requires the headphones to be updated to the latest firmware and paired with an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone. 实时翻译覆盖信息、电话和 FaceTime，其中电话与 FaceTime 限一对一通话。AirPods 翻译需适配耳机更新至最新固件，并与启用 Apple 智能的 iPhone 配对。

The first batch of features is applicable to the iPhone 15 Pro series, the entire iPhone 16 series and subsequent models, as well as iPhone Air, iPhone Duo. Siri and device language must be set to Simplified Chinese or English. 首批功能适用于 iPhone 15 Pro 系列、iPhone 16 全系列及后续机型，以及 iPhone Air、iPhone Duo，Siri 和设备语言须设为简体中文或英语。

It is worth noting that this domestic update provides the first batch of Apple Intelligence features, and the new Siri AI version previewed at WWDC 2026 is not included. 值得注意的是，此次国行更新提供的是首批 Apple 智能功能，WWDC 2026 预告的新版 Siri AI 未包含在内。

🔗 Related reading: Overnight hands-on with iPhone's domestic AI: highlights and drawbacks are all here 🔗 相关阅读： 连夜实测 iPhone 国行 AI，亮点和槽点都在这了

item.title: 苹果天气出现数据异常，多地下周五「跌至」零下 32 度
item.guid: 苹果天气出现数据异常，多地下周五「跌至」零下-32-度
item.description:
Swipe left to view more content 向左滑动查看更多内容

Early this morning, Apple's built-in Weather App showed abnormal forecast data in several Chinese cities, incorrectly displaying next Friday's (November 13) lowest temperature as around -32℃. 今天凌晨，苹果自带天气 App 在国内多个城市出现预报数据异常，将下周五（11 月 13 日）的最低气温错误显示为 -32℃ 左右。

Affected areas cover multiple cities including Beijing, Shanghai, Nanjing, Wuhan, Hefei, Fuzhou, Xi'an, and Kunming, with extreme low temperatures displayed on the page generally concentrated in the -29℃ to -33℃ range. 受影响的区域覆盖北京、上海、南京、武汉、合肥、福州、西安、昆明等多个城市，页面显示的极端低温普遍集中在 -29℃ 至 -33℃ 区间。

For example, the Kunming area page showed that the lowest temperature of the day would plummet to -32℃ between 19:00 and 20:00, while the highest daytime temperature still showed 17℃ to 24℃, with a single-day diurnal temperature range of nearly 50℃. At the same time, weather forecasts for Guangzhou, Shenzhen, Nanning, Haikou, and other areas in Guangdong, Guangxi, and Hainan appeared normal, without similar data. 例如昆明地区页面显示当日最低气温将在 19:00 至 20:00 骤降至 -32℃，而白天最高气温仍显示为 17℃ 至 24℃，单日昼夜温差接近 50℃。与此同时，广州、深圳、南宁、海口等两广及海南地区的天气预报显示正常，并未出现类似数据。

The National Meteorological Center and local meteorological departments have not issued cold wave warnings recently, nor have mainstream numerical forecast models at home and abroad predicted a drastic drop in temperature around November 13. 中央气象台及各地气象部门近期并未发布寒潮预警，国内外主流数值预报模式亦未预测 11 月 13 日前后会有剧烈降温天气。

A meteorological blogger analyzed that the abnormal display's time node coincided with the numerical model forecast node at 20:00 Beijing time (12:00 UTC), speculating that it was caused by algorithmic interpolation and amplification after a deviation occurred in the prediction data for that time. 有气象博主分析指出，异常显示的时间节点恰好处于北京时间 20:00（世界协调时 12:00）的数值模式预报节点，推测系该时次的预测数据出现偏差后经算法插值放大所致。

item.title: 苹果向所有开发者开放 Siri AI，可将多个 App 动作串成任务
item.guid: 苹果向所有开发者开放-Siri-AI，可将多个-App-动作串成任务
item.description:
Apple announced that with the iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS 27.3 beta releases, a new Siri AI developer preview is available, allowing all developers to integrate app content and actions into the new Siri via App Intents. 苹果宣布，随 iOS、iPadOS、macOS 和 visionOS 27.3 测试版开放新的 Siri AI 开发者预览，所有开发者均可通过 App Intents，将应用中的内容与操作接入新版 Siri。

Once integrated, Siri AI can perform in-app actions based on personal context, screen content, and natural language requests, such as checking delivery, making reservations, or placing orders. Apple also introduced "skills," allowing developers to combine multiple actions into a complete experience and enabling Siri AI to retrieve entities from Spotlight's semantic index. 接入后，Siri AI 能结合个人上下文、屏幕内容和自然语言请求执行应用内动作，例如查配送、订位或下单。苹果还引入「技能」，允许开发者把多个操作组合为一次完整体验，并让 Siri AI 检索 Spotlight 语义索引中的实体。

15 Apple apps, including Calendar, Files, Finder, Mail, Maps, Messages, and Photos, have begun offering related capabilities, such as finding coffee shops visited last week or archiving files not opened for over a year. Apple stated that these APIs will first be available for developers to explore, with user delivery starting in a few months and App Store submissions opening next spring. 日历、文件、访达、邮件、地图、信息、照片等 15 款苹果应用已开始提供相关能力，例如寻找上周去过的咖啡店、归档超过一年未打开的文件。苹果称，这批接口将先供开发者探索，几个月后开始面向用户交付，明年春季开放 App Store 提交。

The current Siri AI beta requires devices supporting Apple Intelligence and supported languages; Simplified Chinese is not in the current language list, while Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish, and Vietnamese will be added later. 当前 Siri AI 测试版要求支持 Apple 智能的设备及受支持语言；简体中文不在当前语言列表中，繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语将随后加入。

item.title: GPT 爆改 Qwen 权重，团队测试数学成绩提升约 6 倍
item.guid: GPT-爆改-Qwen-权重，团队测试数学成绩提升约-6-倍
item.description:
MIT CSAIL Ph.D. student Rikiya Takehi and collaborators unveiled a "weight space programming" experiment: allowing GPT-6 Astra to directly read and modify the weights of Qwen3.5-0.8B without using gradient descent or training loops. In the team's MATH-500 test, the modified model's average accuracy increased from 7.9% to 48.1%, approximately 6 times the original. MIT CSAIL 博士生 Rikiya Takehi 及合作者公布「权重空间编程」实验：让 GPT-6 Astra 直接读取、修改 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的权重，不使用梯度下降或训练循环。在团队的 MATH-500 测试中，修改后模型的平均准确率由 7.9% 升至 48.1%，约为原来的 6 倍。

The experiment provided Astra with a Python environment for weight manipulation and math practice materials without test set problems. The best-performing round allowed up to 50 forward calls for the model to check generated results and internal states; the final edits involved approximately 0.016% of the weights. The team stated that Astra identified and weakened directions that caused the small model to fall into repetitive reasoning, focusing on modifying parts of the MLP output columns in layers 15 and 19. 实验向 Astra 提供权重操作用的 Python 环境，以及不含测试集题目的数学练习材料。效果最好的这一轮允许最多 50 次前向调用，供模型检查生成结果和内部状态；最终编辑涉及约 0.016% 的权重。团队称，Astra 找到并削弱了使小模型陷入重复推理的方向，集中修改第 15 层和第 19 层的部分 MLP 输出列。

In the same round of testing, GSM8K accuracy increased from 13.8% to 67.1%, and IFEval strict instruction following accuracy increased from 21.0% to 62.3%. The team has publicly released experiment prompts, code, evaluations, and weight differentials; the authors later also shared the reconstructed model and an online demo. 同一轮测试中，GSM8K 准确率由 13.8% 升至 67.1%，IFEval 严格指令遵循准确率由 21.0% 升至 62.3%。团队已公开实验提示、代码、评测和权重差分；作者随后还分享了重建后的模型及在线演示。

🔗 Related Reading: GPT-6 Astra Drastically Modifies Qwen's Brain: Only 0.016% Parameters Changed, Math Scores Soar 🔗 相关阅读： GPT-6 Astra 爆改 Qwen 大脑：只动 0.016% 参数，数学成绩疯涨

item.title: OpenAI 用 Astra 一周设计语音 Codex 设备，并与马自达合作研究
item.guid: OpenAI-用-Astra-一周设计语音-Codex-设备，并与马自达合作研究
item.description:
OpenAI announced a hardware design experiment: two team members used GPT-6 Astra to complete the design of a device capable of voice interaction with Codex in less than a week of spare time, and a contract manufacturer subsequently produced a small batch of prototypes in less than a month. OpenAI 公布一项硬件设计实验：两名团队成员利用 GPT-6 Astra，在不到一周的业余项目时间内完成一台可与 Codex 语音交互的设备设计，代工商随后用不到一个月制作出小批原型。

The model participated in the design of the casing and internal structure, component selection, PCB layout and wiring, as well as interface, firmware, and Codex software integration. After entering the manufacturing phase, the team still conducted multiple rounds of review and iteration to address production limitations, tolerances, and assembly details not fully considered by the model. 模型参与了外壳和内部结构设计、元件选择、PCB 布局与连线，以及界面、固件和 Codex 软件集成。进入制造阶段后，团队仍进行了多轮审查与迭代，解决模型未充分考虑的生产限制、公差与装配细节。

The company also announced research collaboration with Mazda, allowing the model to assist aerodynamic and crash safety engineers in designing, simulating, and evaluating automotive solutions. Collaboration with Chip Ganassi Racing is exploring the conversion of 3D scans of existing parts into editable CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, with outputs checked by team engineers for accuracy and manufacturability. 公司同时宣布与马自达开展研究合作，让模型辅助空气动力学和碰撞安全工程师设计、模拟及评估汽车方案。与 Chip Ganassi Racing 的合作则在探索将现有零件的 3D 扫描转换为可编辑 CAD 模型和二维制造图纸，输出由车队工程师检查准确性与可制造性。

On BenchCAD 2.0, which tests 3D part reconstruction, assembly, and circuit board connection recognition, OpenAI disclosed that a newer internal model achieved an average score of 0.875, while GPT-6 Astra's highest inference tier scored 0.594. 在测试三维零件重建、装配和电路板连接识别的 BenchCAD 2.0 上，OpenAI 披露一款较新的内部模型平均得分为 0.875，GPT-6 Astra 最高推理档为 0.594。

item.title: 曝 DeepSeek V5 拟用昇腾预训练
item.guid: 曝-DeepSeek-V5-拟用昇腾预训练
item.description:
"STAR Market Daily" cited multiple industry sources stating that DeepSeek's next-generation large model V5 plans to be pre-trained based on Huawei's Ascend chips. Previously, Ascend chips primarily handled inference tasks for DeepSeek models. 《科创板日报》援引多名产业链人士消息称，DeepSeek 下一代大模型 V5 计划基于华为昇腾芯片进行预训练。此前，昇腾芯片主要承担 DeepSeek 模型的推理任务。

The report summarized that DeepSeek open-sourced infrastructure components for Ascend on September 30, including the TileLang compilation tool, computing libraries like DeepGEMM and FlashMLA, and the DeepEP distributed communication library, corresponding to its previous components for the Nvidia platform. 报道梳理，DeepSeek 于 9 月 30 日开源了面向昇腾的基础设施组件，包括 TileLang 编译工具、DeepGEMM 和 FlashMLA 等计算库，以及 DeepEP 分布式通信库，与此前面向英伟达平台的组件对应。

Huawei, in turn, provides jointly defined supernode and networking solutions, and opens up underlying programming interfaces and instruction support. 华为则提供联合定义的超节点及组网方案，并开放底层编程接口和指令支持。

On the training side, teams like Shenzhen Hetao College had previously completed full-parameter post-training of DeepSeek-V4-Pro relying on the Ascend 910C cluster; the reported plan for V5 involves foundational pre-training for the next-generation model. 在训练侧，深圳河套学院等团队此前已依托昇腾 910C 集群完成 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 的全参数后训练；V5 传出的计划则涉及下一代模型的基础预训练。

item.title: DeepSeek 又崩了
item.guid: DeepSeek-又崩了
item.description:
On the afternoon of November 3, DeepSeek's website and API services experienced partial outages. First Financial reporters tested and found that the chat function was unusable, with the chat interface displaying "Server busy, please try again later." 11 月 3 日下午，DeepSeek 网页与 API 服务出现部分中断。第一财经记者测试发现，对话功能无法使用，聊天界面提示「服务器繁忙，请稍后重试」。

Official status information shows that the outage started at 16:58, affecting conversational services, DeepSeek V4 Pro API, and V4.1 Flash API. The services then entered a repair and monitoring phase. 官方状态信息显示，故障从 16:58 开始，受影响的包括对话服务、DeepSeek V4 Pro API 和 V4.1 Flash API。服务随后进入修复与监控阶段。

As of around 9 PM that evening, DeepSeek's official status page showed "everything running normally," with all systems operating as expected. 截至当晚 21 时许，DeepSeek 官方状态页显示「一切运行正常」，各项系统均按预期运行。

item.title: 红果用户规模超越豆包，千问领跑亿级 App 增速榜
item.guid: 红果用户规模超越豆包，千问领跑亿级-App-增速榜
item.description:
QuestMobile released its Autumn Mobile Internet Report and Value Ranking on November 3. In September, within ByteDance Group, the top three applications by deduplicated total users became Douyin, Hongguo Free Short Dramas, and Doubao, with approximately 1.029 billion, 430 million, and 419 million users respectively, with Hongguo surpassing Doubao. QuestMobile 于 11 月 3 日发布秋季移动互联网报告及实力价值榜。9 月，抖音集团内部按去重总用户量计算，前三大应用变为抖音、红果免费短剧和豆包，分别约为 10.29 亿、4.3 亿和 4.19 亿，红果已超过豆包。

Qianwen ranked first in user growth among apps with over 100 million monthly active users, with approximately 158 million MAU and a year-on-year growth of 5077%. The top five on this list also include Douyin E-commerce, Doubao, Hongguo Free Short Dramas, and Soda Music. In the AI-native app MAU ranking, Doubao, Qianwen, and DeepSeek still hold the top three positions, with DeepSeek's MAU being approximately 123 million. 千问则以约 1.58 亿月活、同比增长 5077%，位居月活过亿 App 的用户规模增长榜首。该榜前五还包括抖音商城、豆包、红果免费短剧和汽水音乐。在 AI 原生 App 月活榜中，豆包、千问和 DeepSeek 仍分列前三，DeepSeek 月活约为 1.23 亿。

Short dramas also absorbed more usage time. The report shows that the total usage time for short drama videos increased by a net 13.329 billion hours, short videos by a net 5.717 billion hours, while online videos declined by 1.38 billion hours. The two short video segments combined contributed 111.5% of the total network usage time increase. 短剧同时吸走更多使用时长。报告显示，短剧视频总使用时长净增 133.29 亿小时，短视频净增 57.17 亿小时，在线视频则下滑 13.8 亿小时。两条短视频赛道合计贡献全网使用时长增量的 111.5%。

item.title: 盗用 AI 平台算力，上海一男子获刑三年
item.guid: 盗用-AI-平台算力，上海一男子获刑三年
item.description:
Shanghai's first case involving the use of AI to forge signatures and misappropriate large model computing power was recently sentenced in the first instance. The Paper learned from the Xuhui District Procuratorate on November 2 that the defendant, Zong, was sentenced to three years in prison, suspended for three years, and fined 40,000 yuan for the crime of illegally obtaining computer information system data. 上海首例利用 AI 伪造签名、盗用大模型算力案近日一审宣判。澎湃新闻 11 月 2 日从徐汇区检察院获悉，被告人宗某某因犯非法获取计算机信息系统数据罪，被判有期徒刑三年、缓刑三年，并处罚金 4 万元。

According to the procuratorial authorities, Zong used AI to write automated registration scripts and forge electronic signatures, bypassing the platform's registration and call restrictions, and built his own relay website to sell image and video generation services at low prices. By the time of the incident, he had illegally called platform interfaces over 290,000 times, with illegal gains exceeding 34,000 yuan. 据检察机关介绍，宗某某利用 AI 编写自动化注册脚本、伪造电子签名，绕过平台的注册和调用限制，自建中转网站低价出售图片、视频生成服务。至案发，他非法调用平台接口 29 万余次，违法所得 3.4 万余元。

The platform involved in the case did not provide paid API calling services to external parties, and its user agreement prohibited automated crawling and bypassing verification. Its accounts had also been batch-banned due to violations. The handling prosecutor stated that calling interfaces requires legal authorization. 涉案平台未向外部提供 API 付费调用服务，用户协议禁止自动化抓取和绕过验证，其账号也曾因违规被批量封禁。承办检察官表示，调用接口需要获得合法授权。

item.title: 中兴否认出售手机业务传闻
item.guid: 中兴否认出售手机业务传闻
item.description:
Regarding the news that ZTE plans to cooperate with internet giants and others to establish a joint venture to take over its mobile phone business, ZTE responded to "Science and Technology Innovation Board Daily" on November 3, stating: "It is not true." 针对中兴通讯拟与互联网大厂等合作成立合资公司、承接其手机业务的消息，中兴通讯 11 月 3 日向《科创板日报》回应称：「不属实。」

Previously, Leifeng.com cited sources from relevant company employees saying that ZTE was in talks with a certain internet giant about mobile phone business cooperation, with a plan involving ZTE, the internet giant, and Shanghai state-owned assets jointly establishing a joint venture. 此前，雷峰网援引相关公司员工消息称，中兴正在与某互联网大厂商谈手机业务合作，方案涉及由中兴、该互联网大厂及上海国资共同成立合资公司。

The scope of assets mentioned in the report includes consumer-oriented domestic and international mobile phone businesses, while Red Magic mobile phone business is not within the proposed package. 报道所述资产范围为面向消费者的国内外手机业务，红魔手机业务不在拟打包范围内。

item.title: Claude Code 产品负责人 Cat Wu 离开 Anthropic
item.guid: Claude-Code-产品负责人-Cat-Wu-离开-Anthropic
item.description:
Cat Wu, Product Lead for Claude Code and Cowork, posted on X today that she has left Anthropic, with last Friday being her final day at the company. Claude Code 和 Cowork 的产品负责人 Cat Wu 今天在 X 发文称已离开 Anthropic，上周五是她在 Anthropic 的最后一天。

She recalled in her post that two years ago, when Claude Code was just an internal tool, she asked it to build an RL environment. She spent dozens of hours guiding it, but didn't write a single line of code manually throughout the process, and the task was eventually completed, leading her to join the team. 据她在文中回忆，两年前 Claude Code 还只是内部小工具时，她让它搭建一个 RL 环境。她花了几十个小时引导，但全程没有手动写过一行代码，最终任务完成，她也因此加入了团队。

She mentioned that when the product was first launched, most users would manually approve each permission prompt, mainly using Claude to answer questions and write tests. Now, the default approach is to trust Claude's judgment and let it auto-approve; Claude can now complete large migrations and build entirely new products. In her post, she thanked the teams behind Claude Code, Cowork, and Tag, as well as the users. 她提到，产品刚推出时，多数用户会手动批准每一条权限提示，主要用 Claude 回答问题和编写测试。如今的默认做法是信任 Claude 的判断，让它自动批准，Claude 已能完成大型迁移，也能打造全新产品。她在帖文中感谢了 Claude Code、Cowork 和 Tag 背后的团队以及用户。

Cat Wu previously worked as an engineer at Scale AI and Dagster, then at venture capital firm Index Ventures, before joining Anthropic in August 2024, initially as a Product Manager for research. Cat Wu 早年在 Scale AI 和 Dagster 担任工程师，之后在风投机构 Index Ventures 工作，2024 年 8 月加入 Anthropic，起初负责研究方向的产品经理工作。

item.title: 姚顺宇否认创业：仍是 Google DeepMind 员工
item.guid: 姚顺宇否认创业：仍是-Google-DeepMind-员工
item.description:
"I have not founded a company and am currently still an employee of Google DeepMind." AI researcher Yao Shunyu denied the online rumors about preparing to establish a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) company to The Paper Technology on the evening of November 2. This interview, written by reporter Yu Yan, was published on November 3. 「我没有创办公司，目前仍是谷歌 DeepMind 的员工。」针对网传筹备递归自我改进（RSI）公司的消息，AI 研究员姚顺宇 11 月 2 日晚间向澎湃科技作出否认。这篇由记者喻琰采写的采访于 11 月 3 日发布。

Previous rumors claimed that the co-founding team for the related startup project had largely taken shape and was attracting talent from Google DeepMind, Anthropic, and OpenAI. Yao Shunyu responded: "I have no idea where this false information came from." 此前传闻称，相关创业项目的联合创始团队已基本成形，并在吸引 Google DeepMind、Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的人才。姚顺宇回应：「我完全不知道这个假消息是从哪里来的。」

This is his second time recently responding to startup rumors. On October 12, he stated on social media that he currently has no plans to raise funds in China and described himself as "just an ordinary researcher." 这已是他近期第二次回应创业传言。10 月 12 日，他曾在社交平台表示，目前没有在中国融资的计划，并称自己「只是个普通的研究员」。

item.title: 多所高校免费发 Token，同济每周提供 1 亿 Token
item.guid: 多所高校免费发-Token，同济每周提供-1-亿-Token
item.description:
Universities are starting to include AI usage quotas as part of campus public resources. According to Yicai, the University of Science and Technology of China, Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, and Tongji University have successively provided free tokens or computing power accounts to their faculty and students. 高校开始把 AI 使用额度纳入校园公共资源。据第一财经报道，中国科学技术大学、北京邮电大学、同济大学已先后向师生提供免费 Token 或算力账户。

USTC launched the "Token Plan" in the middle of the year, providing every student and faculty member with 100 million tokens daily, which reset to zero the next day, allowing them to call models such as DeepSeek, GLM, and Qianwen. 中科大年中推出「词元计划」，面向全体在校师生提供每人每天 1 亿 Token，次日清零重置，可调用 DeepSeek、GLM 和千问等模型。

Tongji University launched an AI service platform on October 26, providing each teacher and student with an AI account, distributing 1000 points weekly, equivalent to 100 million Tokens; the platform integrates model invocation, intelligent application development, practical teaching, and multimodal generation. 同济大学 10 月 26 日上线人工智能服务平台，为每位师生提供 AI 账号，每周发放 1000 积分，折合 1 亿 Token；平台整合模型调用、智能应用开发、实践教学和多模态生成。

Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications adopted another approach: its "Everyone Has Computing Power" platform, launched in September, opened free accounts for nearly 10,000 undergraduate and postgraduate freshmen, integrating over 10 large models and intelligent agents. 北邮采用另一种方式：9 月上线的「人人有算力」平台为近万名本科和研究生新生开通免费账户，集成 10 余种大模型与智能体。

Students gain access to a self-configurable virtual server environment, allowing them to directly invoke deployed models and develop intelligent agents. 学生获得可自主配置的虚拟服务器环境，可直接调用已部署模型、开发智能体。

item.title: 蔚来累计换电突破 1.3 亿次，最近 1000 万次用时 88 天
item.guid: 蔚来累计换电突破-1.3-亿次，最近-1000-万次用时-88-天
item.description:
NIO announced that at 18:53:21 on November 3, the cumulative number of battery swaps exceeded 130 million, with an average daily swap volume of over 110,000. It took NIO 1506 days to go from the 1st to the 10 millionth swap; the time taken to go from 120 million to 130 million swaps was shortened to 88 days. 蔚来宣布，11 月 3 日 18:53:21，累计换电次数突破 1.3 亿次，日均换电单量超过 11 万次。从第 1 次到第 1000 万次换电，蔚来用了 1506 天；从 1.2 亿次到 1.3 亿次，用时缩短至 88 天。

As of that day, NIO had deployed 4236 battery swap stations nationwide, with 1077 located on expressways, connecting 550 cities, forming a "9 vertical, 11 horizontal, 16 major city clusters" high-speed battery swap network. The company stated that 84.5% of users can find at least one battery swap station within 3 kilometers of their residence or workplace. 截至当天，蔚来在全国布局 4236 座换电站，其中 1077 座位于高速公路，连接 550 座城市，形成「9 纵 11 横 16 大城市群」高速换电网络。公司称，84.5% 的用户在居住地或工作地周边 3 公里内可找到至少一座换电站。

Regarding the charging network, NIO also has 5556 charging stations and 32261 charging piles, with a cumulative total of 9792 charging and swapping stations built; 92 "power-up scenic routes" have been opened, with plans to reach 100 within the year. 充电网络方面，蔚来另有 5556 座充电站、32261 根充电桩，累计建成充换电站 9792 座；已贯通 92 条加电风景线，计划年内达到 100 条。

item.title: Seedance 海外收入占比达一半，腾讯与 B 站成为国内大客户
item.guid: Seedance-海外收入占比达一半，腾讯与-B-站成为国内大客户
item.description:
According to "Intelligent Emergence," the overseas revenue share of ByteDance's video generation model Seedance has reached 50%. Sources close to Volcano Engine stated that its overseas revenue has grown nearly fivefold in the past six months. 据《智能涌现》报道，字节跳动视频生成模型 Seedance 的海外收入占比已达 50%。接近火山引擎的人士称，过去半年，其海外收入增长近 5 倍。

The main customers in the domestic market are still internet companies. The report cited sources saying that, measured by Token consumption and revenue contribution, Tencent ranks among the top three Seedance clients in China, and Bilibili is in the top ten. 国内市场的主力客户仍是互联网企业。报道援引知情人士消息称，按 Token 消耗和贡献收入衡量，腾讯位列 Seedance 中国区客户前三，B 站进入前十。

The proportion of physical industry clients has exceeded one-quarter, covering manufacturing, new retail, business services, education, healthcare, telecommunications, automotive, and energy sectors. 实体产业客户数量占比则已超过四分之一，覆盖制造、新零售、商业服务、教育、医疗健康、通信、汽车和能源等领域。

Volcano Engine established the FDE (Frontier Deployment Engineer) team this year, delving into key industries such as automotive, healthcare, and education. President Tan Dai stated at the FORCE conference in June that he hopes Seedance will enter the production environments of various industries, especially high-end productivity manufacturing. 火山引擎今年成立了 FDE（前沿部署工程师）团队，深入汽车、医疗、教育等重点行业。总裁谭待曾在 6 月 FORCE 大会上表示，希望 Seedance 进入各行业的生产环境，特别是高端生产力制造。

item.title: AMD 数据中心收入接近翻倍，第四季度营收指引达 170 亿美元
item.guid: AMD-数据中心收入接近翻倍，第四季度营收指引达-170-亿美元
item.description:
AMD announced its Q3 2026 results, with record revenue reaching $13.4 billion, a 45% year-over-year increase, exceeding the upper end of its previous guidance. GAAP net income was $2.4 billion, with diluted EPS of $1.46; non-GAAP net income was $3.5 billion, with diluted EPS of $2.09. AMD 公布 2026 年第三季度业绩，营收创纪录达到 134 亿美元，同比增长 45%，超过此前指引上限。GAAP 净利润为 24 亿美元，摊薄每股收益 1.46 美元；non-GAAP 净利润为 35 亿美元，摊薄每股收益 2.09 美元。

    Data Center: Revenue of $8.5 billion, a 97% year-over-year increase, primarily driven by demand for EPYC processors and Instinct MI450 series GPUs.

    Client & Gaming: Combined revenue of $3.7 billion, an 8% year-over-year decrease. Client revenue was $2.9 billion, up 7%; gaming revenue was $773 million, down 40%.

    Embedded: Revenue of $1.1 billion, a 29% year-over-year increase. GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins for the quarter were 54% and 56%, respectively.

Lisa Su stated that with the expanded production of Helios rack-scale solutions and "Venice" products, growth is expected to accelerate further in the fourth quarter. The company's Q4 revenue guidance is $17 billion, plus or minus 3%, with the midpoint corresponding to approximately 66% year-over-year growth, and non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be around 55%. 苏姿丰表示，随着 Helios 机架级方案和「Venice」产品扩大生产，预计第四季度增长将进一步加速。公司给出的第四季度营收指引为 170 亿美元、上下浮动 3%，中值对应同比增长约 66%，non-GAAP 毛利率预计约 55%。

item.title: 💡 阿里董事会主席：只有开源才能普及 AI
item.guid: 💡-阿里董事会主席：只有开源才能普及-AI
item.description:
At the opening ceremony of the World Internet Conference Wuzhen Summit on November 3, Alibaba Chairman Joe Tsai stated that open source can reduce R&D costs for SMEs, and is particularly valuable for minority languages and developing countries. He believes that open source allows more regions to participate in AI development and deploy models in their own data centers. 在 11 月 3 日世界互联网大会乌镇峰会开幕式上，阿里巴巴董事会主席蔡崇信表示，开源能降低中小企业研发成本，对小语种和发展中国家尤其有价值。他认为，开源让更多地区能够参与 AI 发展，并可将模型部署在自己的数据中心。

Joe Tsai cited a non-profit organization in Uganda as an example: this organization developed local language models based on Qwen, covering 68 African languages, helping local users overcome language barriers. He stated that Qwen has currently open-sourced over 470 models, with cumulative global downloads exceeding 4 billion, and over 330,000 derived models. 蔡崇信以乌干达的一个非营利组织为例：该组织基于千问开发本地语言模型，已覆盖 68 种非洲语言，帮助当地用户跨越语言门槛。他表示，千问目前已开源超过 470 款模型，全球累计下载量突破 40 亿次，衍生模型超过 33 万个。

He also emphasized that openness should include the sharing of talent, ideas, data, and tools. Alibaba's ModelScope community has attracted 33 million users from 239 countries and regions worldwide, with participants from China, the United States, India, Southeast Asia, Africa, and Latin America. 他还强调，开放应包括人才、想法、数据与工具的共享。阿里运营的魔搭社区已吸引全球 239 个国家和地区的 3300 万用户，参与者来自中国、美国、印度、东南亚、非洲和拉丁美洲等地区。

Joe Tsai stated that AI applications are scaling up in industrial manufacturing, healthcare, public services, enterprise office, and scientific research, with demand continuously increasing. Chinese enterprises choose to open models and ecosystems, hoping to involve more people through sharing. For the next stage, the issues he raised include how to more equitably share intelligent knowledge and how to collectively address AI ethics and governance issues. 蔡崇信表示，AI 应用正在工业制造、医疗健康、公共服务、企业办公和科技研发等领域规模化，需求持续增加。中国企业选择开放模型与生态，是希望通过共享让更多人参与进来。对于下一阶段，他提出的议题包括如何更公平分享智能知识，以及如何共同解决 AI 伦理与治理问题。

item.title: 英伟达与 Pika 基于 MiniMax H3 开源视频增强和生成模型
item.guid: 英伟达与-Pika-基于-MiniMax-H3-开源视频增强和生成模型
item.description:
MiniMax H3 welcomes two external open-source projects: Open-H3-Regenerate-2K from NVIDIA and the MIT team, and H3 Flex released by Pika on October 29. The former fills the gap in high-resolution video regeneration, while the latter targets faster joint video and audio generation. MiniMax H3 迎来两项外部开源项目：英伟达与 MIT 团队的 Open-H3-Regenerate-2K，以及 Pika 于 10 月 29 日发布的 H3 Flex。前者补上高分辨率视频重生成环节，后者面向更快的视频、声音联合生成。

Open-H3-Regenerate-2K freezes the H3 backbone and video VAE, refining details of low-resolution drafts through LoRA and a three-step diffusion repaint. The project supports processing drafts generated by H3 or other models into resolutions like 2K, native 4K, etc., handling 5 to 15 seconds of video at a time. Open-H3-Regenerate-2K 冻结 H3 主干与视频 VAE，通过细化 LoRA 和三步扩散重绘低分辨率草稿的细节。项目支持将 H3 或其他模型生成的草稿处理为 2K、原生 4K 等分辨率，单次可处理 5 至 15 秒视频。

Pika H3 Flex reduces denoising from 50 steps to 6 steps, open-sourcing adaptive weights and inference code. It covers text-to-video generation, keyframe generation, and multimodal reference generation, simultaneously producing audio. The open model natively outputs 480p or 768p; 1080p, 2K, 4K upscaling and audio track separation are provided by Pika's hosted services. Pika H3 Flex 将去噪从 50 步压至 6 步，开放生成适配权重和推理代码，覆盖文本生成视频、首尾帧生成及多模态参考生成，并同步生成音频。开放模型原生输出为 480p 或 768p；1080p、2K、4K 放大和音频分轨由 Pika 托管服务提供。

item.title: 商汤发布 SenseNova 6.8 Flash，支持动态设计与可编辑 3D 工程
item.guid: 商汤发布-SenseNova-6.8-Flash，支持动态设计与可编辑-3D-工程
item.description:
SenseTime launched the official version of SenseNova 6.8 Flash on November 2nd, with updates focusing on multi-step task collaboration, long-term memory, and design delivery. The model is now available on SenseNova Studio and Token Plan, and SenseTime's Little Raccoon also offers a limited-time free trial. 商汤于 11 月 2 日推出 SenseNova 6.8 Flash 正式版，围绕多步骤任务协作、长期记忆及设计交付进行更新。模型已上线 SenseNova Studio 和 Token Plan，商汤小浣熊也提供限时免费体验。

Design features cover web pages, SVG, Three.js, Blender, and PPT, and can integrate with the Figma workflow. SenseTime states that the model can coordinate transitions, element entry, and chart animations when generating PPTX; when collaborating with Blender, it can modify scenes round by round based on actual rendering results and user feedback, outputting editable projects. This dynamic 3D demonstration relies on local environment setup and multi-round user interaction. 设计功能覆盖网页、SVG、Three.js、Blender 和 PPT，并可衔接 Figma 工作流。商汤称，模型可在生成 PPTX 时统筹转场、元素入场和图表动效；与 Blender 协作时，可根据实际渲染结果及用户反馈逐轮修改场景，输出可继续编辑的工程。这项动态 3D 演示依赖本地环境搭建和用户多轮交互。

SenseTime also showcased an office use case involving long-term memory and proactive interaction: linking information about new products supporting private deployment with previous customer demands lost due to lack of such support, reminding sales to follow up again. This proactive interaction demonstration is based on an internal beta version of Little Raccoon. 商汤还展示了长期记忆与主动交互的办公案例：将新产品支持私有化部署的信息，与此前因不支持该功能而流失的客户需求关联，提醒销售重新跟进。该主动交互演示基于小浣熊内部测试版。

item.title: 法拉利首款电动车 Luce，2027 年产量已全部被预订
item.guid: 法拉利首款电动车-Luce，2027-年产量已全部被预订
item.description:
Ferrari CEO Benedetto Vigna stated on the Q3 earnings call that the production quota for the company's first electric vehicle, Luce, for 2027 has been fully allocated, and new customers will need to wait approximately one year for delivery. The first deliveries are expected to begin in the fourth quarter. 法拉利 CEO Benedetto Vigna 在第三季度财报电话会上表示，公司首款电动车 Luce 的 2027 年生产配额已全部分配，新客户需要等待约一年才能提车。首批交付预计于第四季度开始。

According to TechCrunch, this five-seater electric vehicle was designed by former Apple design chief Jony Ive and sparked design controversy when it debuted in May. Vigna stated that pre-ordering customers have a good mix in terms of type and geographical distribution, with no specific demographic pattern. 据 TechCrunch 报道，这款五座电动车由前苹果设计主管 Jony Ive 操刀，5 月亮相时曾引发设计争议。Vigna 称，预订客户在类型和地域分布上都有良好组合，没有特定的人群模式。

Ferrari has not yet disclosed the planned production volume for Luce. The company also mentioned in this earnings report that personalized customization demands and the delivery of the limited-edition supercar F80 boosted performance, with the customization business now accounting for over 20% of automotive and parts revenue. 法拉利尚未公开 Luce 的计划产量。公司在本次财报中还提到，个性化定制需求及限量超跑 F80 交付推动了业绩，定制业务已占汽车及零部件收入的逾两成。

item.title: 美团 LongCat-2.5 正式发布，国产算力训练原生多模态模型
item.guid: 美团-LongCat-2.5-正式发布，国产算力训练原生多模态模型
item.description:
Meituan officially released LongCat-2.5 on November 2nd, designed for long-range agent tasks requiring continuous execution. The model has a total of 1.6 trillion parameters, with approximately 48 billion parameters activated per token, enhancing native visual understanding and agent programming capabilities. 美团于 11 月 2 日正式发布 LongCat-2.5，面向需要持续执行的长程智能体任务。模型总参数量为 1.6 万亿，每个 Token 激活约 480 亿参数，强化了原生视觉理解和智能体编程能力。

The new model converts images into multi-level discrete tokens, which are processed alongside text by the same backbone model, supporting visual programming, creative design, and 3D tasks. Training tasks come from public GitHub repositories and internal real-world code scenarios. The team also restored agent failure trajectories into reproducible, testable tasks, strengthening complex codebase development and complete project construction capabilities. 新模型把图像转为多层级离散 Token，与文字交给同一主干模型处理，支持看图编程、创意设计和 3D 任务。训练任务来自 GitHub 公开仓库及内部真实代码场景，团队还将 Agent 的失败轨迹还原为可复现、带测试的任务，补强复杂代码库开发和完整项目构建能力。

Training and inference are optimized around domestic AI accelerator cards. In Meituan's tested long-sequence supervised fine-tuning tasks, single-card throughput increased by 86% compared to the DDP baseline; in online stress tests, W4A4 quantization improved pre-fill and decoding throughput by 43.3% and 42.77% respectively, compared to the W8A8 baseline. The model now offers online experience and API access. 训练和推理围绕国产 AI 加速卡优化。在美团测试的长序列监督微调任务中，单卡吞吐较 DDP 基线提升 86%；线上压测中，W4A4 量化相较 W8A8 基线，使预填充和解码吞吐分别提升 43.3% 和 42.77%。模型已提供在线体验和 API 接入。

item.title: 智能投影销量连跌四季，第三季度中国市场下滑 26.2%
item.guid: 智能投影销量连跌四季，第三季度中国市场下滑-26.2%
item.description:
According to data released by RUNTO on November 3rd, cited by Jiemian News, China's smart projector market sales in Q3 2026 were 829,000 units, a year-on-year decrease of 26.2%; sales revenue was 1.23 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 27.1%. The statistics do not include laser TVs. The market has seen four consecutive quarters of year-on-year decline, with each quarter's drop exceeding 20%. 据界面新闻援引洛图科技 11 月 3 日发布的数据，2026 年第三季度中国智能投影市场销量为 82.9 万台，同比下降 26.2%；销售额为 12.3 亿元，同比下滑 27.1%。统计不含激光电视，市场已连续四个季度同比下滑，各季跌幅均超过 20%。

While the market contracts, online brand concentration is rising. The top ten brands by sales volume accounted for a combined 74% share in Q3, and the top ten brands by sales revenue accounted for a combined 81.7%. XGIMI ranked first in both online sales volume and revenue, followed by Big Eyes Orange in sales volume and Konka in third; JMGO ranked second in sales revenue. 市场收缩的同时，线上品牌集中度上升。第三季度销量前十品牌的合计份额达 74%，销额前十品牌合计占 81.7%。极米位居线上销量、销额双榜第一，大眼橙销量第二、康佳第三；坚果则位居销额第二。

RUNTO also lowered its full-year retail volume forecast to 3.857 million units, a year-on-year decrease of 25.9%; full-year sales revenue is expected to be 6.28 billion yuan, a year-on-year decrease of 24.8%. 洛图科技还将全年零售量预测下调至 385.7 万台，同比下降 25.9%；预计全年销额为 62.8 亿元，同比下降 24.8%。

item.title: 佳能计划明年起调价，应对零部件成本上涨
item.guid: 佳能计划明年起调价，应对零部件成本上涨
item.description:
Canon stated in its Q3 2026 analyst Q&A that the company is working to secure the supply of scarce components needed for next year, expects procurement costs to rise, and plans to offset cost increases by raising selling prices starting in 2027. The company will make long-term pricing decisions by comprehensively considering sales volume and profitability. 佳能在 2026 年第三季度分析师问答中表示，公司正设法确保明年所需的紧缺零部件供应，预计采购成本将上升，计划从 2027 年起通过提高售价抵消成本增长。公司会综合考虑销量与盈利，作出长期价格决策。

The original Q&A also differentiated the supply status of various businesses: the printing and imaging businesses also face component shortages, but due to proactive measures, they have not been significantly affected; the medical business, however, due to operational issues after production system updates, failed to order sufficient components in time, and is expected to secure supply meeting current production plans only by Q2 next year. 原始问答还区分了各业务的供应状况：打印和影像业务也面临零部件短缺，但因提前应对，尚未受到重大影响；医疗业务则因生产系统更新后的运营问题，未能及时下单采购足量零部件，预计到明年第二季度才能取得满足当前生产计划的供应。

Canon expects that memory and raw material prices will not decrease next year, and related costs will impact full-year operations. 佳能预计，明年的内存和原材料价格不会下降，相关成本将影响全年经营。

item.title: 全国放心消费平台上线，扫码可查周边商家承诺
item.guid: 全国放心消费平台上线，扫码可查周边商家承诺
item.description:
The State Administration for Market Regulation officially launched the National Assured Consumption Platform on November 3rd. Consumers can access it by searching for the "Consumption Check" mini-program or scanning an offline assured consumption QR code. The platform displays nearby businesses based on location, with over 10,000 assured consumption units and 100 assured consumption clusters already onboarded in the first batch. 市场监管总局 11 月 3 日正式上线全国放心消费平台，消费者搜索「消费查」小程序或扫描线下放心消费码即可进入。平台会按定位展示周边商家，首批已有超 1 万个放心消费单元、100 个放心消费集聚区入驻。

After businesses register, make online commitments, and pass verification for public display, they can obtain a "one store, one code" assured consumption QR code and a nationally unified identifier. The platform has initially integrated with Baidu Maps, Meituan Waimai, Taobao Flash Sale, and JD Waimai, allowing the same business's identifier to be displayed across multiple entry points. 商家注册、在线承诺并经核验公示后，可获得「一店一码」的放心消费码和全国统一标识。平台首批已对接百度地图、美团外卖、淘宝闪购和京东外卖，让同一商家的标识在多个入口展示。

Consumers can view business licenses, store photos, after-sales methods, consumption commitments, and reviews on a business's homepage, and can also navigate, review, or call the business with one click. For businesses that engage in illegal or dishonest conduct, refuse to fulfill commitments, or shirk reasonable demands, regulatory authorities will, after verification, order them to exit the platform and revoke their offline consumption QR codes and identifiers. 消费者可在商家主页查看证照、门店实景、售后方式、消费承诺和评价，也能一键导航、评价或电话联系商家。对发生违法失信行为、拒不履行承诺或推诿合理诉求的商家，监管部门查实后将责令其退出平台，并收回线下消费码与标识。

item.title: 《好莱坞往事》衍生片再请《社交网络》配乐搭档
item.guid: 《好莱坞往事》衍生片再请《社交网络》配乐搭档
item.description:
Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross will score David Fincher's new film 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth,' marking their sixth cinematic collaboration with Fincher. A new poster revealed the scoring lineup, and the film will be exclusively released in IMAX for two weeks starting November 25, then available on Netflix on December 23. Trent Reznor 与 Atticus Ross 将为大卫·芬奇的新片《The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth》配乐，这是两人与芬奇在电影上的第六次合作。新海报公布了配乐阵容，影片将于 11 月 25 日在 IMAX 独家上映两周，12 月 23 日上线 Netflix。

The film is written by Quentin Tarantino and is a spin-off of 'Once Upon a Time in Hollywood,' set eight years after the original, centering on Cliff Booth, played by Brad Pitt. The cast also includes Elizabeth Debicki, Carla Gugino, and Timothy Olyphant, among others. 影片由昆汀·塔伦蒂诺编剧，是《好莱坞往事》的衍生作品，故事发生在前作八年后，围绕布拉德·皮特饰演的 Cliff Booth 展开。演员还包括伊丽莎白·德比茨基、卡拉·古奇诺和蒂莫西·奥利芬特等。

Reznor and Ross began scoring Fincher's films with 'The Social Network' in 2010, for which they won an Academy Award for Best Original Score; their collaboration continued with 'The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo,' 'Gone Girl,' 'Mank,' and 'The Killer.' Reznor 与 Ross 从 2010 年《社交网络》开始为芬奇电影配乐，并凭该片获得奥斯卡最佳原创配乐奖；此后合作延续至《龙纹身的女孩》《消失的爱人》《曼克》和《杀手》。

item.title: 《蓝眼武士》第二季定档明年 1 月，复仇之旅转向伦敦
item.guid: 《蓝眼武士》第二季定档明年-1-月，复仇之旅转向伦敦
item.description:
Netflix announced that the second season of 'Blue Eye Samurai' will premiere on January 19, 2027, with a total of six episodes. The journey of the mixed-race swordswoman Mizu will extend from Edo-era Japan to London as she continues her search for two other men who might be her father. Netflix 宣布，《蓝眼武士》（Blue Eye Samurai）第二季将于 2027 年 1 月 19 日上线，共六集。混血剑客 Mizu 的旅程将从江户时代的日本延伸至伦敦，继续寻找另两名可能是她父亲的男子。

Creators Amber Noizumi and Michael Green stated that the new season is set in London in 1657, where Mizu will enter the local underworld and confront the challenges of being an Asian woman in British society at that time. They mentioned that the team spent three years researching and illustrating these historical settings. 主创 Amber Noizumi 和 Michael Green 表示，新一季设定在 1657 年的伦敦，Mizu 将进入当地的地下世界，并面对身为亚洲女性在当时英国社会的处境。两人称，团队花了三年时间研究并绘制这些历史场景。

Maya Erskine continues to voice Mizu, with new voice actors including Jonathan Pryce, Joel Kim Booster, and Sherry Cola. Netflix also confirmed that this story arc will conclude in 2028. Maya Erskine 继续为 Mizu 配音，新增配音演员包括 Jonathan Pryce、Joel Kim Booster 和 Sherry Cola。Netflix 同时确认，这段故事将在 2028 年迎来终章。

item.title: Netflix 测试 AI Discover，按心情找片还能屏蔽不想看的推荐
item.guid: Netflix-测试-AI-Discover，按心情找片还能屏蔽不想看的推荐
item.description:
Netflix announced it is testing a new feature called AI Discover in its TV app, initially rolling out to a small number of English-speaking, supported device members in the US, with a gradual expansion planned over the coming weeks. Netflix 宣布在电视 App 中测试新栏目 AI Discover，先向美国使用英语、设备受支持的少量会员开放，并将在未来几周逐步扩大范围。

The initial experience revolves around finding content by theme: users can start with themes like 'Something Light,' 'Scare Me,' 'Family Movie Night,' or 'Short Watch,' view matching lists, then select more specific themes to narrow down choices, or use 'Something Different' to get new recommendations. 首批体验围绕主题找片：用户可以从「轻松一点」「吓吓我」「家庭电影夜」或「短时间观看」等主题进入，查看匹配片单，再选择更细的主题继续缩小范围，或用「换些不一样的」获得新推荐。

Next to each title, a new 'Adjust Recommendation' button will be added, alongside 'Play' and 'Add to List.' Users can keep the recommendation or request that the title not be recommended again in the future; AI Discover will remember feedback to reduce repetition. 每部作品旁会新增调整推荐按钮，与播放、加入片单并列。用户可以保留该推荐，或要求以后不再推荐这部作品；AI Discover 会记住反馈，减少重复出现。

Netflix stated that this feature is powered by a new intelligent layer that adjusts in real-time based on member input. The company will decide which experiences to keep and improve based on usage and feedback, and some features may also be integrated into the main interface. Netflix 表示，这一栏目由新的智能层驱动，会根据会员输入实时调整。公司将据使用情况和反馈决定保留、改进哪些体验，部分功能也可能进入主界面。

item.title: 三周年倒计时｜人人都爱贴贴线
item.guid: 三周年倒计时｜人人都爱贴贴线
item.description:
Only 1 day left until the third anniversary of the Sugar Factory MagTie cable. 距离制糖工厂贴贴线三周年，还有 1 天。

Three years ago, to solve the small problem of data cables easily tangling and being difficult to store, the first self-magnetic cable – MagTie – was born. Over these three years, from MagTie to Cloud Cable, Flower Cable, Thin Lightning Cable, Thin Lightning Cable Pro, and MagTie Roll, this family has gradually taken on different forms: softer, more personalized, faster, and with more space-saving options. What remains unchanged is the idea of making daily connections more convenient. 三年前，为了解决数据线容易缠绕、收纳麻烦的小问题，第一根会自己磁吸的线——MagTie 贴贴线诞生了。三年里，从贴贴线到云朵线、花线、细雳线、细雳线 Pro 和贴贴卷，这个家族逐渐有了不同的模样：更柔软、更有个性、更高速，也有更省空间的选择。不变的，是让日常连接更顺手的想法。

On the occasion of our third anniversary, we'd also like to hear: which one is your favorite, and what daily moments have you shared with it? Feel free to share your MagTie stories as we celebrate the third anniversary and look forward to major benefits! 三周年之际，我们也想听听：你最喜欢哪一款，又和它一起度过了哪些日常？欢迎分享你的贴贴故事，一起迎接三周年，蹲蹲重磅福利！

Claude Code GPT-6 Astra OpenAI Siri
